taxa.research_note: Historical species-level name connected to the disputed Norwegian cyanescens record. O 177904 was examined under P. arcana in Borovička 2008. Borovička et al. 2011 found no sequence variation across three markers among P. serbica, P. bohemica, P. arcana and P. moravica, merging them into P. serbica and retaining arcana below species level as P. serbica var. arcana. Species Fungorum ID 515724 and NCBI TaxID 797116 refer to the variety. The Norwegian voucher itself has not been shown to carry a public DNA sequence and remains catalogued P. cf. arcana.

original.Notes: Historical species-level name connected to the disputed Norwegian cyanescens record. O 177904 was examined under P. arcana in Borovička 2008. Borovička et al. 2011 found no sequence variation across three markers among P. serbica, P. bohemica, P. arcana and P. moravica, merging them into P. serbica and retaining arcana below species level as P. serbica var. arcana. Species Fungorum ID 515724 and NCBI TaxID 797116 refer to the variety. The Norwegian voucher itself has not been shown to carry a public DNA sequence and remains catalogued P. cf. arcana.
original.Name: Psilocybe arcana
